import hashlib
import json
import logging
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
import traceback
import uuid
from time import monotonic

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / 'ownership-integration/.audit'))
from complete_main_onboarding_native import observation

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'tests/integration'))
import hidden_desktop

source = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
output = Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
if not hidden_desktop.is_child(output):
    assert not (output / 'result.json').exists(), 'Use a fresh output directory'
    hidden_desktop.DESKTOP = f'FrontEngineColdReload{os.getpid()}_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}'
    before = observation()
    code = hidden_desktop.run_on_hidden_desktop(__file__, str(source), str(output), timeout_ms=180000)
    (output / 'observer.json').write_text(json.dumps({'before': before, 'after': observation(),
        'child_exit': code, 'observation_only': True}, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    raise SystemExit(code)

os.environ['QT_QPA_PLATFORM'] = 'windows'
expected = json.loads((source / 'shutdown-world.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
result = {'passed': False}
try:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='fe-current-cold-reload-') as folder:
        shutil.copytree(source / 'settings', folder, dirs_exist_ok=True)
        protected_path = Path(folder) / 'pet-home.json'
        payload = json.loads(protected_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        payload['version'] += 1
        protected_path.write_text(json.dumps(payload), encoding='utf-8')
        original = protected_path.read_bytes()
        backup_bytes = protected_path.with_suffix('.json.bak').read_bytes()
        recovery = 'restore' if output.name.endswith('restore') else 'aside'
        previous = Path.cwd()
        os.chdir(folder)
        try:
            from PySide6.QtCore import QCoreApplication, QEvent
            from PySide6.QtTest import QTest
            from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
            from frontengine.ui.page.pet_game import home_page
            from frontengine.utils.session_lock import session_lock
            from frontengine.user_setting.user_setting_file import user_setting_dict
            from frontengine.utils.pet_game import snapshot

            home_page.workshop_pack_roots = lambda: []
            session_lock.is_session_locked = lambda: False
            app = QApplication([])
            app.setQuitOnLastWindowClosed(False)
            from frontengine.ui import main_ui
            main_ui.CriticalExit.init_critical_exit = lambda self: None
            main_ui.HotkeyService.start = lambda self: False
            main_ui.AppProfileService.start = lambda self: None
            main_ui.ShareWatchService.start = lambda self: None
            window = main_ui.FrontEngineMainUI(show_system_tray_ray=False, redirect_output=False)
            lifetime = window.lifetime
            page = window.pet_home_ui
            try:
                window.resize(1280, 960)
                window.show()
                page.refresh()
                QTest.qWait(500)
                assert page.load_result.status == 'newer'
                assert page.service.world is None and page.service.store.read_only
                assert page.update_button.isVisible() and page.aside_button.isVisible()
                assert not page.create_button.isVisible()
                assert page.status.text().strip()
                assert window.grab().save(str(output / 'newer-save-protected.png'))
                page.create_home()
                assert page.service.world is None
                assert protected_path.read_bytes() == original
                if recovery == 'restore':
                    expected_backup = json.loads(backup_bytes)
                    assert page.restore_button.isVisible()
                    page.restore_button.click()
                    assert page.load_result.status == 'loaded'
                    assert snapshot.to_dict(page.service.world) == expected_backup
                    assert set(page.service.sessions) == set(page.service.world.residents)
                    assert page.service.save_now()
                    assert protected_path.with_suffix('.json.bak').read_bytes() == backup_bytes
                    result['backup_snapshot_restored'] = True
                else:
                    page.aside_button.click()
                    kept = list(Path(folder).glob('pet-home.json.kept*'))
                    assert len(kept) == 1 and kept[0].read_bytes() == original
                    assert page.load_result.status == 'missing' and page.create_button.isVisible()
                    page.create_button.click()
                    assert page.service.world is not None
                    assert page.service.world.home != expected['home']
                    assert page.service.save_now()
                    assert kept[0].read_bytes() == original
                    result['old_file_kept'] = True
                QTest.qWait(200)
                assert window.grab().save(str(output / 'recovered.png'))
                result['recovery'] = recovery
                result.update(load_status=page.load_result.status, status_text=page.status.text(),
                    update_caption=page.update_button.text(), aside_caption=page.aside_button.text(),
                    blocked_create_verified=True, protected_sha256=hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest())
            finally:
                window.request_shutdown()
                deadline = monotonic() + 120
                while not lifetime.closed and monotonic() < deadline:
                    QCoreApplication.sendPostedEvents(None, QEvent.Type.DeferredDelete)
                    app.processEvents()
                    QTest.qWait(10)
                assert lifetime.closed, (lifetime.state, lifetime.error)
                if recovery == 'aside':
                    assert kept[0].read_bytes() == original
                else:
                    assert protected_path.with_suffix('.json.bak').read_bytes() == backup_bytes
                (output / 'shutdown-world.json').write_text(json.dumps(snapshot.to_dict(page.service.world), indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
                shutil.copytree(folder, output / 'settings', dirs_exist_ok=True)
                result['recovery_saved_after_shutdown'] = True
            result.update(passed=True, runtime_closed=True, python=sys.version,
                source=str(source), saved_snapshot_sha256=hashlib.sha256((source / 'shutdown-world.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                scope='Native MainUI on private desktop, copy of actual six-resident settings with only save version incremented; widget-local recovery button activation on temporary copies; no update URL opened. Host global starts, Workshop and session-lock query substituted.')
        finally:
            logging.shutdown()
            os.chdir(previous)
    result['temporary_directory_removed'] = True
except Exception:
    result.update(passed=False, error=traceback.format_exc())
(output / 'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
raise SystemExit(0 if result['passed'] else 1)
